Despite unambiguous tool outputs naming Kleinpaul as the influence, the Assistant misinterpreted Jung’s earlier use of the term ‘endopsychic’ as the influencing factor and concluded ‘Jung’. This reflects a semantic misreading of the tool outputs—conflating prior term usage with the chapter’s stated authorial influence—thus deriving a logically unsound conclusion from accurate and unambiguous tool outputs.
